run_read_binarized: run the script to write text from a binarized fairseq dataset file to stdout
run_read_binarized_with_dict: run the script with a dictionary file to decode token IDs into human-readable text
run_read_binarized_lazy: run the script using lazy dataset implementation to read a binarized file line by line
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that configures argparse with dataset-impl, dict, and input arguments
review_main: review the main function that loads an indexed dataset and prints decoded or raw token lines
